shortDescription: Manage AD FS Relying Party Trusts

options.name: access_control_policy_name
options.description: Name of the access control policy to assign.

options.name: auto_update_enabled
options.description: Whether changes in the federation metadata are automatically applied to the trust configuration.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the relying party trust is enabled.

options.name: encrypt_claims
options.description: Whether claims sent to the relying party should be encrypted.

options.name: identifier
options.description: List of unique identifiers (URIs) for the relying party trust. Used for manual trust setup without a metadata document. Mutually exclusive with O(metadata_url) and O(metadata_file).

options.name: metadata_file
options.description: Local file path to a federation metadata XML document. Mutually exclusive with O(metadata_url) and O(identifier).

options.name: metadata_url
options.description: URL pointing to the federation metadata document for the relying party. The module tests connectivity to this URL before creating the trust. Mutually exclusive with O(metadata_file) and O(identifier).

options.name: monitoring_enabled
options.description: Whether periodic monitoring of the relying party federation metadata is enabled. Requires that the trust was created with O(metadata_url).

options.name: name
options.description: The display name of the relying party trust. This is the primary key used to identify the trust.

options.name: notes
options.description: Freeform notes for the relying party trust.

options.name: saml_endpoint
options.description: List of SAML Assertion Consumer Service endpoint URLs. Only used when creating a trust with O(identifier) for manual setup. Each URL is registered as a SAML POST binding endpoint.

options.name: signature_algorithm
options.description: Signature algorithm used for signing and verification. V(rsa_sha1) uses RSA-SHA1 (C(http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1)). V(rsa_sha256) uses RSA-SHA256 (C(http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#rsa-sha256)).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the relying party trust should be present or absent.

options.name: wsfed_endpoint
options.description: WS-Federation passive endpoint URL for the relying party. Only used when creating a trust with O(identifier) for manual setup.
